_doc: SERVER SIEGE reel VO. The user's 10 lines, verbatim in meaning (docs/MASTER_PROMPT.md §6), spoken by Bro (the Bro & Bhai series host; ElevenLabs Liam, Turbo v2.5, hi). Each line owns a window on the 120 BPM bar grid (bar 1 at 3.0 s, 2 s per bar) and starts at its window start + lead. 'cap' = Roman Hinglish caption (the user's words), 'tts' = what the voice reads (Devanagari Hindi + English words; '10 LAKH' spoken as दस लाख, '3D' as three-D).

reel.cap: 10 LAKH requests! Aur mera server… gaya!
reel.tts: दस लाख requests! और मेरा server… गया!

reel.cap: Toh maine banaya SERVER SIEGE — ek playable 3D system-design simulator!
reel.tts: तो मैंने बनाया Server Siege — एक playable three-D system-design simulator!

reel.cap: Traffic badhao… requests line mein lagti hain, latency badhti hai, aur errors start!
reel.tts: Traffic बढ़ाओ… requests line में लगती हैं, latency बढ़ती है, और errors start!

reel.cap: Easy fix? Aur servers add kar do! Load balancer sabko traffic distribute karega.
reel.tts: Easy fix? और servers add कर दो! Load balancer सबको traffic distribute करेगा।

reel.cap: Lekin ruk… database hi overload ho gaya! Sirf servers badhane se problem solve nahi hui.
reel.tts: लेकिन रुक… database ही overload हो गया! सिर्फ servers बढ़ाने से problem solve नहीं हुई।

reel.cap: Ab cache enable karo. Repeated reads ka load kam hota hai, aur database ko breathing room milta hai!
reel.tts: अब cache enable करो। Repeated reads का load कम होता है, और database को breathing room मिलता है!

reel.cap: Autoscaling bhi lagao — traffic badhe toh new instances automatically ready ho sakein.
reel.tts: Autoscaling भी लगाओ — traffic बढ़े तो new instances automatically ready हो सकें।

reel.cap: Capacity, caching aur queue ko balance karo… aur system recover kar sakta hai!
reel.tts: Capacity, caching और queue को balance करो… और system recover कर सकता है!

reel.cap: Best part? Ye scripted animation nahi. Har control ke peeche actual simulation logic hai!
reel.tts: Best part? ये scripted animation नहीं। हर control के पीछे actual simulation logic है!

reel.cap: Tum apne server ko bacha paoge? Comment SERVER!
reel.tts: तुम अपने server को बचा पाओगे? Comment SERVER!
